{{Top|leg}}
'''Southwood Speeder Rental Business''' was a speeder rental company on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] circa [[3956 BBY]]. [[Handon Guld]] and [[Calder Nettic]] are known to have rented a speeder together from this company.

==Behind the scenes==
The exact name of this speeder rental company is revealed to Revan by a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] assisting [[Bolook]] at the scene.
